name: aivy-mcp
description: Read and control your own solar + battery system: Sungrow, Sigenergy, FoxESS, AlphaESS, SolaX.
long_description: Ask Claude what your battery is doing, what Amber Electric prices look like, when to sell tonight, and let it set the energy mode or an alert. Sign up or sign in from the chat; the key stays on this computer. Works with every brand Aivy runs. Manual (forced) modes set here are time-boxed and hand back automatically; the engine's SOC floor and export limits cannot be overridden.

api_key.title: Aivy API key (optional)
api_key.description: Leave empty to sign up or sign in from the chat. Or paste a key from https://bridge.ivyenergy.com.au/developer (read only, or read and control).
